documents.text: Mike Crossey, known for his work with Arctic Monkeys and Foals. The 1975 were selling out shows even before the debut of their full length as Healy recalls in an interview with "The AU Review". The lead single is a re-worked "Sex", which was released on 26 August 2013. The song premiered on Zane Lowe's BBC Radio 1 show on 8 July 2013, and a music video premiered on YouTube on 26 July. "The 1975" debuted at number one on the UK Albums Chart. The 1975 toured in the UK in September 2013, among others performing in Kingston upon Hull
